title: Cinnamon Girl
tuning: D A D G B D
feel: Heavy riff with ringing open D strings, about 132 bpm (estimate)

sections.name: Riff 1
sections.note: Riff 1 is a single-note figure: read it from Howard Wright's tab.

sections.name: Verse
sections.note: Then riff 2, twice per verse. The solo runs over the verse chords.

sections.name: Middle 8
sections.bars: Cadd2 | Am11 | Cadd2 | Am11 | Cadd2 | Am11 | Gm7 | % | Am7

why: **Double drop D**, one-finger 6-string barres for m7 chords (Gm7 and Am7 are a barre plus two notes), and riff-plus-chord playing.
hard_change: **Middle-8 Gm7 → Am7**: the whole shape slides two frets at volume.
theory: I–v–♭VII–IV over D (Mixolydian/Dorian mixture). The middle 8's iv7 → v7 (Gm7–Am7) are both borrowed minors.
steps: Retune to double drop D. The verse chords alone, slowly.
With the record (ending riff after the solo).
tips: Some charts call Cadd2 “Cadd9” (same notes) and add a G/B passing chord.
caveat: Tuning and chords are well sourced; riff 1's detail is single-source — trust your ear and your teacher's version.
